about_the_game:
The story continues with Missing Hearts: Crimson Cruise DLC and four brand-new locations packed with danger, secrets, and revelations about the vampire conspiracy. Step deeper into the shadows of Fortune’s Dream as you uncover hidden clues, stop sinister transformations, and unravel the schemes of the Vampire Council. Each new setting challenges you with more hidden object scenes, clever puzzles, and thrilling mini-games — all while delivering answers that bring you closer to the heart of the mystery.

Prepare for hours of fresh gameplay as you search every corner of the ship and beyond. From forbidden halls to secret bunkers, every step leads you further into the unknown. Trust your instincts, sharpen your eyes, and dare to face the dangers that lurk just out of sight. This DLC brings more mysteries to solve, more dangers to overcome, and more truth to uncover.

💕 Staff Cabins

Investigate the crew’s quarters, where whispers of betrayal and hidden caches may expose who aided the disappearances. Nothing is as simple as it seems in these narrow corridors!

💕 Abandoned Dance Floor

Once full of laughter, now a place of shadows. Cameras caught someone sneaking inside — and the secret cargo might hold the answer to stopping a vampire’s transformation.

💕 Waiter’s Quarters

When a servant collapses under a dark curse, you must act quickly to restrain him before the infection spreads. Every clue could be the key to saving lives — or losing them.

💕 Council Bunker

Hidden beneath the ship’s foundations lies a forgotten stronghold. Break into the Vampire Council’s records to uncover names, plans, and secrets that could decide humanity’s fate.

Dare to uncover the truth — the fate of every soul depends on you. The night is growing darker…
